title: Longest Semi-Repeating Subarray
description:
You are given an integer array `nums` of length `n` and an integer `k`.

A **semi‑repeating** subarray is a contiguous subarray in which at most `k` elements repeat (i.e., appear more than once).

Return the length of the longest **semi‑repeating** subarray in `nums`.
hints: Analyze the constraints and data structures appropriate for Longest Semi-Repeating Subarray.
Formulate an optimal state transition or traversal invariant.
Consider corner testcases and boundary limits.
